categories.main_business_segments: Boji Medical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing comprehensive one-stop services across the entire new drug development process. Its main business segments include clinical research services, preclinical research services, other consulting services, Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services, independent preclinical drug research and development, and technology transfer services. The company also has subsidiaries focusing on specialized areas such as traditional Chinese medicine clinical research, medical device clinical research and registration, and international registration services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including AI-assisted molecular design for chemical drug development, GLP-certified preclinical safety evaluation, and GMP-compliant clinical trial drug production. It has developed multiple R&D platforms such as drug innovative formulation development, pharmacology and toxicology evaluation, clinical trial simulation drug production, and small molecule and peptide drug research. The CDMO segment includes production of raw materials, traditional Chinese medicine processing, and various dosage forms like tablets, capsules, eye drops, and topical gels. The company also emphasizes technology transfer and patent development in both chemical and traditional Chinese medicines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Boji serves domestic and international pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, and research institutions engaged in new drug and medical device development. Key customers include large pharmaceutical enterprises and innovative biomedicine companies requiring integrated CRO services. The company supports clinical trials in various therapeutic areas such as liver disease, oncology, endocrinology, immunology, rare diseases, and traditional Chinese medicine. It also provides registration and regulatory consulting services for markets including China, the US, and the EU.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a broad domestic presence covering major regions including East China, South China, North China, Central China, Northeast, Southwest, and Northwest China. It also has overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong and the United States, providing international registration and clinical research services. The company’s service network includes over 900 clinical trial institutions across China and maintains strategic cooperation with hospitals and research centers nationwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Boji Medical Technology operates primarily as a midstream service provider in the pharmaceutical R&D supply chain, offering contract research and development services from preclinical stages through clinical trials to drug registration. Additionally, it extends downstream into contract manufacturing and production (CDMO) of clinical trial drugs and intermediates. The company integrates upstream drug discovery and formulation development with downstream clinical trial execution and regulatory submission, positioning itself as a full-process CRO/CDMO service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes expanding its full-process one-stop CRO services, strengthening clinical research capabilities especially in innovative drugs and traditional Chinese medicine, and developing CDMO manufacturing capacity. It prioritizes R&D in innovative drug formulations, nanocrystal and lipid-based delivery systems, nasal and transdermal drug delivery platforms, and pediatric formulations. The company actively pursues AI integration in drug design and clinical trial management, enhances talent recruitment and training, and promotes internationalization through dual China-US regulatory filings.
categories.revenue_model: Boji generates revenue primarily through service fees from clinical research, preclinical research, consulting, and CDMO manufacturing contracts. Revenue is recognized based on contract progress and delivery of research services or product batches. The company also earns income from technology transfer and licensing of proprietary drug research outcomes. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to pharmaceutical and medical device companies, with staged payments aligned to contract milestones and project progress.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Boji is positioned as a leading domestic CRO company in China, ranked among the top 20 Chinese pharmaceutical CRO enterprises and recognized for its comprehensive full-process service capabilities. It competes with other fast-growing domestic CROs specializing in compound screening, preclinical pharmacology, toxicology, and clinical research. The company differentiates itself by offering integrated services across the entire drug development chain and maintaining strong expertise in both chemical and traditional Chinese medicine sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Boji achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 742 million, representing a 33.5% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 28.78 million, up 18.23%. The company’s contract backlog was about RMB 2.76 billion at year-end, indicating strong growth momentum. Total assets reached RMB 1.45 billion with a slight increase from the previous year. The company maintains a stable financial position with a manageable debt ratio around 31%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Boji emphasizes its unique full-process one-stop CRO service model that integrates preclinical research, clinical trials, regulatory consulting, and manufacturing under one roof, reducing time and cost for clients. The company leverages its extensive industry experience, high-quality talent pool, and advanced technology platforms to deliver reliable, efficient, and customized drug development solutions. Its strong capabilities in traditional Chinese medicine and innovative drug areas, combined with dual China-US regulatory filing expertise, provide differentiated value to pharmaceutical clients seeking comprehensive and integrated R&D outsourcing services.
